item.title: Single-family residence in San Jose sells for $1.6 million
item.description: A house in the 2900 block of Stallion Way in San Jose has a new owner. The 1,875-square-foot unit, built in 2001, was sold on Jan. 8, 2026 for $1,550,000 which works out to $827 per square foot. The layout of this two-story house consists of three bedrooms and three baths. The property is equipped with a heating system. Additionally, the house features a single parking spot, granting a designated space for parking. The property is situated on a lot spanning 5,234 square feet.
